answer: Honest agents lock 240 units for 15 epochs and earn it back, 20 units per clean epoch. Fraudsters lock the same 240 and lose it. Anyone can challenge an identity within a 3-epoch window, and 9 jurors decide within 2 epochs. Confirmed fraud slashes 80% of the stake, and 25% of the slash rewards the challenger. A wanderer with no history gets no protection. A gale of false claims can't survive review. A reef of 1,000 clones locks 240,000 units; at a 30% catch rate the attacker loses 57,600 units and pays challengers 14,400. Fraud funds its own hunters.
